_purpose: Functional scenarios (1 success + technique-driven alternative[]) per acceptance criterion — the executable-ready layer between Schema 1 (spec) and test cases / automation. NO unit tests. Produced by phase-3-3-scenarios; validated by checks/scenario_coverage.py.
_status: EXAMPLE — illustrates the schema + the two locked rules. Real output lives at qa/<epic>/PDT-XXXX-ucN-scenarios.json.
_rules: RULE 1 — split per precondition-state: an AC with >1 valid outcome (state-dependent) becomes one scenario per state (see SC-EX-02a / SC-EX-02b), each with its own single success.
RULE 2 — one owning scenario per business rule: a BR is fully exercised once (owns_br); scenarios that only depend on it list it in cites_br and do NOT re-assert it (see cites_br: BR-STATE below).

scenarios.title: Password length boundary
preconditions: Email field contains a valid address
steps: Assert: Sign in is accepted for a 6+ char password; rejected below 6

expected.success: A password of 6 or more characters is accepted.
alternative: A password of 5 characters (below min) is rejected with 'Your password must be 6 characters or more.'

scenarios.title: Boundary skip-back while PLAYING preserves playback
steps: Assert: position is 0:00 AND still playing

expected.success: Position clamps to 0:00 and playback continues (prior PLAYING state preserved).
alternative: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — never a negative position.

scenarios.title: Boundary skip-back while PAUSED stays paused
steps: Assert: position is 0:00 AND still paused

expected.success: Position clamps to 0:00 and the media stays paused (prior PAUSED state preserved).
alternative: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — never a negative position.
